dataset: Ville de Montreal open data, Adresses ponctuelles (resource fed5fd02-5535-458e-b13f-66e7a31a6d78, adresses.csv)
method: published LONGITUDE/LATITUDE of the Ville de Montreal address point ID_ADRESSE 379228 used as published (direct geometry); its MTM zone 8 X/Y agree with the published WGS84 pair when transformed with pyproj 3.7.1
crs_note: The published X/Y are MTM zone 8 coordinates; transformed from NAD83 / MTM zone 8 (EPSG:32188) they agree with the published WGS84 longitude/latitude within the stated distance, and from NAD83(CSRS) / MTM zone 8 (EPSG:2950) within about 1 m. The published WGS84 pair is used unchanged.
